episodes.174927: A stalled warm front and plentiful amounts of atmospheric moisture helped to set the stage for a persistent wet pattern that lasted several days in early December across Middle Tennessee. By December 7, 2022, an estimated 2 to 4 inches over the course of this event had begun to cause creeks to overfill their banks. Minor flooding was reported across areas mainly south of Interstate 40, particularly in the Spring Hill area where several flooding reports were received along with road closures.
